"""Targeted semantic mutations: every one must be rejected by load()."""
import copy, json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import cli, pyref
from test_mutate import load_verdict, py_verdict, shape_ok


def nodes_of(img):
    pyref.validate(img)
    out = []
    for (s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp) in pyref.LAST_NODES:
        w = int(img['banks'][s][c // 2], 16)
        off = 128 if c % 2 else 0
        out.append((s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp, off, pyref.field(w, off, 3), w))
    return out


def setw(img, s, r, w):
    img['banks'][s][r] = format(w & ((1 << 256) - 1), '064x')


def main():
    binary = cli.build()
    rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 5)
    # a rich FIB: every node type, bulk arrays, deep chains, all three forests
    d = {}
    def add(hi, lo, ln, hop=None):
        hi, lo = pyref.norm(hi, lo, ln)
        d[(hi, lo, ln)] = rng.randint(0, 4194302) if hop is None else hop
    base = 0x20010db8_12345678 << 0
    for i in range(70):
        add(base, i << 58, 70, i + 1)          # origin64: TYPE3 with 64-ish bulk children
    for i in range(40):
        add(base, (i << 50) | 7, 128, i + 100)  # deep chains
    for i in range(20):
        add((base >> 16) | (i << 48), 0x1234, 34, i + 200)   # origin16 forests
    for i in range(14):
        add(i << 60, 0, 12, i + 300)            # origin0 forest
    add(0, 0, 0, 12345)                          # default route
    add(0x0000_00ff << 48, 0, 16, 777)           # longest owner0 prefix
    prefixes = sorted([(k[0], k[1], k[2], v) for k, v in d.items()])
    img = pyref.build_image(prefixes, rng)
    assert py_verdict(img) is True
    assert load_verdict(binary, img) is True
    N = nodes_of(img)
    types = {}
    for n in N:
        types[n[8]] = types.get(n[8], 0) + 1
    print('nodes', len(N), 'types', types)
    addrs = ['%016x%016x' % (rng.getrandbits(64), rng.getrandbits(64)) for _ in range(6)]
    addrs += ['%016x%016x' % (k[0], k[1]) for k in list(d)[:6]]

    fails = []

    def expect_reject(name, mutant):
        if not shape_ok(mutant):
            fails.append((name, 'shape violation (would be invalid request)'))
            return
        c = load_verdict(binary, mutant)
        p = py_verdict(mutant)
        if c is not False:
            fails.append((name, 'C++ accepted (%r) py=%r' % (c, p)))
            json.dump({'mutant': mutant, 'base': img}, open('accept_%s.json' % name, 'w'))
        elif p is not False:
            fails.append((name, 'python accepted, C++ rejected'))

    # 1 wrong BMP on every node type
    for want_t in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5):
        cand = [n for n in N if n[8] == want_t]
        if not cand:
            continue
        s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp, off, t, w = cand[0]
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        setw(m, s, c // 2, (w & ~(0x3FFFFF << off + 3)) | (((bmp + 1) & 0x3FFFFF) << (off + 3)))
        expect_reject('bmp_t%d' % want_t, m)
    # 2 reserved bit set
    for want_t in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5):
        cand = [n for n in N if n[8] == want_t]
        if not cand:
            continue
        s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp, off, t, w = cand[0]
        rpos = {1: 127, 2: 255, 3: 249, 4: 119, 5: 213}[want_t]
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        setw(m, s, c // 2, w | (1 << (off + rpos)))
        expect_reject('reserved_t%d' % want_t, m)
    # 3 child stage equal to parent
    cand = [n for n in N if n[8] in (1, 2, 3)]
    done = False
    for n in cand:
        s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp, off, t, w = n
        cpos = off + 63 if t != 3 else off + 153
        v = pyref.field(w, cpos, 32)
        if v == (15 << 6):
            continue
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        nv = (v & ~(0xF << 6)) | ((s & 0xF) << 6)
        setw(m, s, c // 2, (w & ~(0x3FFFFFFFF << cpos)) | (nv << cpos))
        expect_reject('child_stage_eq', m)
        done = True
        break
    if not done:
        print('WARN: no child found for stage test')
    # 4 bogus type value
    s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp, off, t, w = N[0]
    m = copy.deepcopy(img)
    setw(m, s, c // 2, (w & ~(7 << off)) | (6 << off))
    expect_reject('type6', m)
    m = copy.deepcopy(img)
    setw(m, s, c // 2, w & ~(7 << off))
    expect_reject('type0', m)
    # 5 inline host bit set
    cand = [n for n in N if n[8] in (4, 5)]
    for n in cand:
        s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp, off, t, w = n
        rel = None
        # find a prefix with a host bit inside the record
        rl = pyref.field(w, off + 25 + 64, 8)
        if rl == 0 or rl >= 64:
            continue
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        setw(m, s, c // 2, w | (1 << (off + 25)))   # lowest fragment bit = host bit
        expect_reject('frag_host', m)
        break
    # 6 bitmap pattern bit0
    if img['bitmaps']:
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        m['bitmaps'] = list(img['bitmaps'])
        m['bitmaps'][0] = format(int(img['bitmaps'][0], 16) | 1, '016x')
        # keep sorted order valid
        vals = [int(x, 16) for x in m['bitmaps']]
        if any(vals[i] <= vals[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(vals))):
            m['bitmaps'] = [format(x, '016x') for x in sorted(set(vals))]
        expect_reject('bitmap_bit0', m)
    # 7 unsorted / duplicated front keys
    if len(img['front64']) >= 2:
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        m['front64'][0], m['front64'][1] = m['front64'][1], m['front64'][0]
        expect_reject('front_unsorted', m)
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        m['front64'] = [m['front64'][0], list(m['front64'][0])] + m['front64'][1:]
        expect_reject('front_dup', m)
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        m['front64'] = m['front64'][1:]
        expect_reject('front_missing', m)
    # 8 remove one bitmap entry (now unknown id / unused)
    if len(img['bitmaps']) >= 2:
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        m['bitmaps'] = m['bitmaps'][:-1]
        expect_reject('bitmap_dropped', m)
    # 9 NI base shifted
    cand = [n for n in N if n[8] in (1, 2, 3)]
    for n in cand:
        s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp, off, t, w = n
        bid = pyref.field(w, off + 25, 16)
        if bid >= len(img['bitmaps']) or pyref.field(w, off + 41, 22) >= len(img['nexthops']):
            continue
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        setw(m, s, c // 2, (w & ~(0x3FFFFF << (off + 41))) | (((pyref.field(w, off + 41, 22) + 1) & 0x3FFFFF) << (off + 41)))
        expect_reject('ni_base', m)
        break
    # 10 cells count vs rows
    m = copy.deepcopy(img)
    m['cells'] = list(img['cells'])
    for s in range(11):
        if m['cells'][s] >= 2:
            m['cells'][s] -= 2
            break
    expect_reject('cells_short', m)
    m = copy.deepcopy(img)
    m['cells'] = list(img['cells'])
    m['cells'][0] += 2
    expect_reject('cells_long', m)
    # 11 zero out a whole record
    m = copy.deepcopy(img)
    setw(m, N[0][0], N[0][1] // 2, 0)
    expect_reject('zero_record', m)
    # 12 bulk base misaligned / bulk stage bumped
    t3 = [n for n in N if n[8] == 3]
    if t3:
        s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp, off, t, w = t3[0]
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        setw(m, s, c // 2, (w & ~(0x3FFFFF << (off + 127))) | (((pyref.field(w, off + 127, 22) + 2) & 0x3FFFFF) << (off + 127)))
        expect_reject('bulk_base', m)
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        bstage = pyref.field(w, off + 149, 4)
        setw(m, s, c // 2, (w & ~(0xF << (off + 149))) | ((s & 0xF) << (off + 149)))
        expect_reject('bulk_stage', m)
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        setw(m, s, c // 2, (w & ~(0x3FFFFF << (off + 127))) | ((pyref.field(w, off + 127, 22) | 1) << (off + 127)))
        expect_reject('bulk_odd', m)
    # 13 hop null marker inside an inline record
    cand = [n for n in N if n[8] in (4, 5)]
    if cand:
        s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp, off, t, w = cand[0]
        m = copy.deepcopy(img)
        pos = off + 25 + 64 + 8
        setw(m, s, c // 2, (w & ~(0x3FFFFF << pos)) | (4194303 << pos))
        expect_reject('inline_null_hop', m)
    # 14 empty image sanity + junk
    empty = {'root': None, 'front16': [], 'front64': [], 'cells': [0] * 11,
             'banks': [[] for _ in range(11)], 'bitmaps': [], 'nexthops': []}
    if load_verdict(binary, empty) is not True:
        fails.append(('empty_image', 'rejected valid empty image'))
    junk = copy.deepcopy(empty)
    junk['cells'][3] = 2
    junk['banks'][3] = ['0' * 64]
    expect_reject('empty_junk', junk)

    if fails:
        for f in fails:
            print('FAIL', f)
        return 1
    print('targeted mutations all rejected consistently')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
